build_2d_sincos_pos_embed: build a 2D sine-cosine position embedding for a square grid with optional cls token
build_flexible_2d_sincos_pos_embed: build a 2D sine-cosine position embedding for a non-square grid with flexible height and width
build_1d_sincos_pos_embed: build a 1D sine-cosine position embedding from a list of positions using outer product
interpolate_pos_embed_for_vision_model: interpolate position embeddings from a checkpoint to a new model with different patch size
interpolate_pos_embed_img2audio: interpolate position embeddings from an image checkpoint to an audio model with different grid dimensions
